completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-1: src/forge/lifecycle_bridge/translation.py exposes a StreamEventTranslator class with method translate(stream_part: StreamPart, context: BuildContext) -> PipelineEvent | None.
completion_promises.evidence: Created src/forge/lifecycle_bridge/translation.py with class StreamEventTranslator. Method `translate(self, stream_part: StreamPart, context: BuildContext) -> PipelineEvent | None` is defined and verified by tests/forge/lifecycle_bridge/test_translation.py::TestTranslatorSurface (test_class_is_importable, test_translate_signature). The method walks the StreamPart, requires correlation_id, infers feature_id, extracts the AutobuildState snapshot, diffs against the prior snapshot (per-feature_id) and dispatches to a typed payload constructor.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-2: The translator handles every documented StreamPart.event value the langgraph-runner sidecar emits during an autobuild run; unknown events return None and are logged at DEBUG (not WARNING - unknown events are routine during langgraph-api minor bumps).
completion_promises.evidence: translate() inspects stream_part.event; only the 'values' StreamPart event is actioned (it carries the AutobuildState snapshot). Every other event ('metadata', 'messages', 'updates', 'events', 'end', 'custom') returns None and emits logger.debug() — explicitly verified by TestUnknownEventBehaviour: test_unknown_event_returns_none, test_unknown_event_logs_at_debug_not_warning (asserts NO records at WARNING+), and test_unknown_event_does_not_raise (parametrized over six event names).

completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-3: Each typed payload constructed by the translator carries correlation_id from BuildContext.correlation_id (no fallback; raises if missing).
completion_promises.evidence: _require_correlation_id() runs first in translate() and raises MissingCorrelationIdError(ValueError) if BuildContext.correlation_id is missing/empty (no silent fallback). Every payload constructor (_build_started, _build_complete, _build_failed, _build_paused, _build_resumed, _build_cancelled, _build_stage_complete) either passes correlation_id= as a keyword (v2 payloads: paused/resumed/cancelled/stage-complete) or pairs construction with attach_correlation_id_to_v1_payload() (v1 payloads: started/complete/failed). Verified by TestCorrelationIdRequired (raise paths) and the AST guard TestTranslatorEmitSitesThreadCorrelationId (every payload site threaded).

completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-4: A contract test round-trips a known AutobuildState mutation sequence through a recorded SSE stream fixture and validates the emitted pipeline.* envelopes against the nats_core.events Pydantic schemas. Fixture lives at tests/forge/lifecycle_bridge/fixtures/sse_stream_canonical.jsonl (records both success and failure paths).
completion_promises.evidence: Created tests/forge/lifecycle_bridge/fixtures/sse_stream_canonical.jsonl recording (a) the success path (starting -> planning_waves -> running_wave [build-started] -> running_wave w/ stage delta [stage-complete] -> completed [build-complete]) and (b) the failure path (starting -> running_wave -> failed). tests/forge/lifecycle_bridge/test_translation_contract.py replays the JSONL through StreamEventTranslator and asserts: each emitted payload matches the fixture's _expected_envelope tag (TestSuccessPathRoundTrip); the failure path terminal is BuildFailedPayload carrying the inbound correlation_id (TestFailurePathRoundTrip); no double-emits (TestNoDoubleEmits); pydantic round-trip works and correlation_id is non-empty (TestSchemaContract). Fixture re-record requirement is documented in fixtures/__init__.py for AC-5 bumps.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AC-6: F010C correlation-id AST guard fixture extended with the new emit sites the translator introduces (via downstream emitter calls in T4 - coordinate with T4 author on the call-site list).
completion_promises.evidence: Extended tests/forge/test_pipeline_consumer_correlation_id.py with TestTranslatorEmitSitesThreadCorrelationId. The new AST guard walks src/forge/lifecycle_bridge/translation.py and asserts every PipelineEvent payload construction either (a) passes correlation_id= as a keyword (v2 payloads) or (b) is paired with an attach_correlation_id_to_v1_payload() call in the same function (v1 payloads — they ignore unknown kwargs at construction time per ConfigDict(extra='ignore'), so post-hoc attachment is the canonical pattern). Sanity floor: at least BuildStartedPayload, StageCompletePayload, BuildCompletePayload, and BuildFailedPayload constructions are observed. The guard fails loud the moment a future translator change adds a payload construction without threading the field.
